description:
INSTALLATION OF A SINGLE EXTERNAL AIR CONDITIONING CONDENSER
UNIT (AIR TO AIR HEAT PUMP) ON THE EXISTING FLAT ROOF OF THE PROPERTY.

waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: The proposal relates solely to the installation of an external air conditioning unit to an existing flat. No new residential or non-residential units are created, and waste storage arrangements remain unchanged.

text-autospace:none"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">Noise
from proposed air-to-air heat pump external condenser unit to which the
application refers shall not exceed a level 5 dB(A) below the existing lowest
LA90(15min) background noise level at any time when the plant is operating. The
noise emitted shall be measured or predicted at 1.0m from the facade of the
nearest residential premises or at 1.2m above any adjacent residential garden,
terrace, balcony or patio. The unit shall be serviced regularly in accordance
with the manufacturer's instructions and as necessary to ensure that the
requirements of the condition are maintained. If at any time the plant is
determined by the local planning authority to be failing to comply with this
condition, it shall be switched off upon written instruction from the local
planning authority and not used again until it is able to comply.<o:p></o:p></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0cm;text-align:justify;line-height:

subdivision_of_building: The proposal affects only the roof level of the existing building and relates solely to the installation of a single external air conditioning condenser unit serving the applicant’s top-floor one-bedroom flat. No works are proposed to the remainder of the building or to any other residential units within the property.
